title: Scientific Marketing Manager (f/m/x) for Diagnostic Products
desc:
Your responsibilities
As Scientific Marketing Manager (f/m/x) for Diagnostic Products with a focus on Clinical Flow Cytometry, Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and PCR, you will act as a key scientific partner driving evidence-based marketing strategies and enabling successful market adoption across EMEA. You will translate complex clinical and scientific insights into impactful communication, while ensuring strong alignment between scientific credibility and commercial objectives.
Your key responsibilities include:
Driving scientific marketing initiatives by aligning clinical insights with business objectives and supporting market entry and adoption across EMEA
Leading and executing clinical studies, including planning, protocol development, monitoring and data analysis for flow cytometry, IHC and PCR
Translating complex scientific and clinical data into clear, compelling and compliant messaging and campaigns for diverse target audiences
Generating and leveraging scientific evidence (e.g., studies, publications, congress contributions) to strengthen product positioning and value proposition
Building and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs to capture voice of customer and support evidence-based decision-making
Designing and executing scientific engagement activities such as advisory boards, symposia, webinars and congress participation
Collaborating cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders to communicate clinical need and enable adoption in clinical routine
Developing and delivering high-quality scientific content and training for internal teams, affiliates, distributors and customers
Monitoring market trends, competitive landscape and scientific developments to inform strategic decisions

Benefits:

Working in an innovative and international environmentwith a broad learning and development landscape in our EMEA Campus, after-work events for internal networking
• Work-life balanceFlexible working through flextime and a hybrid working model (60% mobile working, 40% on-site), 30 days annual leave
• Additional benefitsAttractive compensation package including Christmas and vacation pay, childcare allowance, capital-forming benefits, subsidy for company pension scheme, corporate benefits, relocation assistance, subsidised lunch in our canteen
• Health & wellbeingSubsidized EGYM Wellpass with access to 13,500 studios, plus in-house gym, various sports courses, massages, company medical and psychological care, workplace glasses, and general health management
• MobilitySubsidy for the public transport “Deutschlandticket”, free parking, bike leasing via JobRad
• Social ResponsibilityVarious opportunities to get involved in different sustainability and charity initiatives, climate friendly and respectful use of resources

title: Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager
desc:
Your tasks
The Opportunity
As a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager at commercetools, you will serve as the strategic lead for the company's foundational platform , ecosystem enablers ( Agent Gateway and integrations ) and AI Hub .This role requires a hands-on mastery of modern commerce architecture and AI concepts—including LLMs and agentic systems— to bridge the gap between deep engineering concepts and compelling market storytelling. By acting as a technical peer to Product teams, you will translate innovations like composable architecture into value-driven narratives that help global enterprises experiment and scale.
Your Impact
Drive Platform Differentiation: Refine our platform’s differentiated positioning to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue growth; lead messaging and GTM for related products (AI Hub, Agent Gateway, integrations), ensuring cohesive narratives that highlight business and technical value
AI Evangelism: Translate complex concepts like agentic commerce, LLMs, and API orchestration into clear value propositions for both technical and business audiences.
Joint Propositions: Amplify joint value propositions with key technology partners including Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, and OpenAI.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape launch strategies for new platform capabilities, integrations, and AI-powered features, understanding architectural trade-offs, constraints, and real-world implementation considerations
Audience Insights: Conduct deep research into customer, partner, and developer needs to inform product direction and competitive messaging.
Technical Enablement: Develop grounded content—from demos to thought leadership—that aligns GTM teams and empowers customers to adopt new innovations.
